conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.effect: You cannot see. You are immune to Visual effects. You are Off-Guard.
conditions.description: The world vanishes from sight, leaving you to find your way through danger by your remaining senses.

conditions.name: Bound
conditions.effect: Your implement is in a neutral Bind with [X]’s. The Bind ends if either of you Moves, Steps, or Recenters, or when either of you attacks. Gain Control to get the upper hand in this contest.
conditions.description: Your weapon or shield presses against your foe’s, neither of you yet holding the advantage.

conditions.name: Controlled
conditions.effect: [X] Controls your weapon. You have an Exposed Zone of [X]’s choice while the Bind lasts, and your attacks with that weapon take a -2 Situation penalty. Recenter ❶, Move, or Step to end it.
conditions.description: Your foe forces your weapon out of line, opening a dangerous gap in your defenses.

conditions.name: Controlling
conditions.effect: You Control [X]’s weapon: [X] has an Exposed Zone of your choice. You may Close ❶ on [X]. The Bind ends if a third party attacks you.
conditions.description: You hold your foe’s weapon out of line, keeping their defenses open to attack.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.effect: You cannot hear. You are Immune to Auditory effects. You are Off-Guard.
conditions.description: The world falls silent, cutting off shouted warnings and the telltale sounds of approaching danger.

conditions.name: Dying
conditions.effect: You’re Dying. You may not necessarily be unconscious; you may merely be bleeding out or suffering a similar effect.
conditions.description: Your life is slipping away, and each passing moment brings death closer.

conditions.name: Exposed
conditions.effect: That Zone is Exposed: Hits can land there instead of your Torso. Protection counts as 0. Recenter ❶ to clear unless otherwise stated.
conditions.description: A gap in your defenses offers a clear path past your armor to a vulnerable part of your body.

conditions.name: Fatigued
conditions.effect:
You suffer a -N condition (maximum of 3) penalty to all Defense (Awareness, Endure, Evade, Guard) and Attack checks (checks with the Attack trait). You can Travel, but you may take no other Exploration Mode Activity. You cannot Sustain spells.

Reduce by 1 after every ten minutes of uninterrupted rest, unless otherwise specified.
conditions.description: Weariness drags at your limbs, making each attack and defense an effort.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.effect:
You suffer a -N condition penalty to all checks.

Reduce by 1 at the end of each round.
conditions.description: Fear tightens its grip, making every danger loom larger and every decision harder.

conditions.name: Grabbed
conditions.effect: You are Off-Guard and can't Move or Step. You must successfully Escape ❶ to break free.
conditions.description: A firm grip holds you in place, leaving you to struggle for room to move.

conditions.name: Heedless
conditions.effect: You have commitment so complete that you have stopped thinking. Maneuvers with the Concentrate trait take 1 extra action.
conditions.description: Your commitment overwhelms caution, leaving little room for careful thought.

conditions.name: Off-Guard
conditions.effect: -2 Situation to Evade and Guard against all foes.
conditions.description: Your defenses have slipped, giving enemies an opening to press their advantage.

conditions.name: Preparing
conditions.effect: You have begun a Maneuver of three or more actions: two actions spent, the rest reserved. You cannot Pass; you finish or abandon at your next Opportunity. Taking a Wound abandons it.
conditions.description: You have committed to a demanding maneuver, its decisive moment still to come.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.effect:
Off-Guard, -2 Situation to Attacks; +2 Situation to Evade vs. ranged Attacks.
Stand ❶ to clear, or Roll Over ❶ to become Prone.
conditions.description: You lie facedown on the ground, struggling to bring your strength to bear from below.

conditions.name: Supine
conditions.effect:
Off-Guard; -2 Situation to Attacks (except melee Attacks against adjacent creatures, Grapples included); +2 Situation to Evade vs. ranged Attacks. You cannot Move, Step, Rush, Leap, or Crawl; forced movement affects you normally.
Stand ❶ to clear (you can stand directly from your back), or Roll Over ❶ to become Prone.
conditions.description: You lie on your back, ready to fend off whatever looms over you.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.effect: As Grabbed but can’t take any action other than Escape ❶.
conditions.description: You are held fast, with no freedom left except the struggle to break loose.

conditions.name: Slowed
conditions.effect: Lose N actions at the start of each round. Reduce N by 1 at the end of each round.
conditions.description: Your movements come sluggishly, letting the fight creep ahead of you.

conditions.name: Spent
conditions.effect:
Every Hit that lands on you inflicts a Wound on the Zone it struck, and a Critical Hit inflicts two.
If you are Hit or Critically Hit and take any Nonlethal damage as a result, you are knocked unconscious. You awake in ten minutes, or sooner if someone rouses you, with 1 Vigor.
conditions.description: Your reserves are exhausted, and every blow that finds its mark threatens lasting harm.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.effect: Lose the next N actions; may carry over across rounds.
conditions.description: Shock leaves you struggling to act while the fight races on around you.

conditions.name: Wounded
conditions.effect: That Zone carries a Wound: its critical effect made lasting (see Chapter 4: Vigor and Wounds). Fill the Torso’s or Head’s Wound capacity (two, for anyone Medium or smaller) and you are Dying.
conditions.description: A serious injury turns a moment’s violence into a lasting burden.

conditions.name: Wrong-Footed
conditions.effect: Off-Guard against that creature only.
conditions.description: One foe has caught you out of position, leaving an opening only they can exploit.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.effect: You are out, Dying or knocked cold: you drop everything you are holding in your squares, and you’re also Prone.
conditions.description: You lie senseless as the world carries on beyond your awareness.

conditions.name: Concealed
conditions.effect: Your foe knows exactly what squares you are in, but something is preventing them from seeing or otherwise detecting all of you. You gain a +2 Situation bonus to Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.
conditions.description: Your foe knows where you are, but whatever veils you makes a clean strike uncertain.

conditions.name: Hidden
conditions.effect: Your foe knows that you are present, but not what squares you occupy. Your foe must successfully guess one of the squares you occupy in order to attack you. Even so, you gain a +4 Situation bonus to Evade and Guard for physical Attacks. Your foe is Wrong-Footed to you.
conditions.description: Your foe knows you are present, but can only guess where a blow might find you.

conditions.name: Undetected
conditions.effect: Your foe has no idea if you are even present. You cannot be targeted at all. Your foe is Wrong-Footed to you.
conditions.description: You escape your foe’s notice entirely, a threat they have no reason to expect.

conditions.name: Dead
conditions.effect: You are dead.
conditions.description: Your life has ended, leaving others to reckon with your absence.
